mainTopic: Finding the source that the קרבן עולה ויורד for טומאה covers קדשים and the מקדש but not תרומה
overview: This amud asks where we learn that the קרבן עולה ויורד for טומאה covers eating holy food (קדשים) and entering the מקדש while טמא, and not eating תרומה while טמא. The גמרא first notes that a sin without כרת can still bring this קרבן, so it tries to exclude תרומה with the word ״בה״. When ״בה״ could just as well exclude the מקדש, רבא praises רבי's deep reading and quotes his ברייתא. That ברייתא is a גזירה שוה on ״בהמה טמאה״ showing the פסוק is about טומאת קודש. A היקש then links the מקדש to קודש, but that would bring in תרומה too, and the reasoning over which case ״בה״ excludes cuts both ways. רבא tries to use the three mentions of כרת by שלמים, and the חכמי נהרדעי try the three mentions of טומאה. Both are rejected because those mentions are already needed for רבי אבהו (or, for רבי שמעון, the חטאת הפנימית). Finally רבא begins a new גזירה שוה on the word ״טומאתו״, which continues on the next amud.

steps.title: A sin without כרת can still bring a sliding-scale offering
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא argues that תרומה could still fit the קרבן עולה ויורד. Lack of כרת does not rule it out, as שמיעת קול and ביטוי שפתים show.
steps.simpleTranslation: Let him bring a sliding-scale offering, just as in the cases of 'hearing the voice' and 'utterance of lips'!
steps.whatsHappening: Someone suggested the verse cannot mean תרומה, because eating תרומה while טמא has no כרת. The גמרא pushes back: lack of כרת does not stop a קרבן עולה ויורד.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Usually a sin offering comes for a sin whose deliberate version carries כרת. But the קרבן עולה ויורד is different. A false oath about testimony (שמיעת קול) and a false spoken oath (ביטוי שפתים) have no כרת, yet both require this קרבן. So תרומה could still be what the verse means.

keyTerms.meaning: A sliding-scale offering: a rich person brings an animal, a poorer person birds, a very poor person flour
A witness who falsely swears he knows no testimony (ויקרא 5:1)
A false oath spoken with the lips (ויקרא 5:4)
Just like the case of…

steps.confusionAlert: Don't assume every קרבן needs a sin with כרת. The קרבן עולה ויורד is the exception, and that is the whole point of this challenge.

phrases.english: Let him bring a sliding-scale offering –
phrases.notes: This answers the claim, just before this line, that eating תרומה while טמא can't need this קרבן because it has no כרת.

phrases.english: just as it is with 'hearing the voice'
phrases.notes: ויקרא 5:1

phrases.english: and with 'utterance of lips'!
phrases.notes: ויקרא 5:4

steps.triggerLanguage: עולה ויורד נייתי מידי דהוה אשמיעת קול ואביטוי שפתים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues an earlier discussion: it rejects the argument that תרומה is excluded because it has no כרת
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that the קרבן עולה ויורד cannot apply to eating תרומה while טמא
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Lack of כרת does not exclude a קרבן עולה ויורד, since שמיעת קול and ביטוי שפתים have no כרת and still require one

steps.title: The word ״בה״ excludes תרומה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that the word ״בה״ in the verse comes to exclude תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: The verse says ״בה״ ('through which'). ״בה״ comes to exclude תרומה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge. It points to the small word ״בה״ in the verse about טומאה, which leaves out תרומה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Logic alone could not exclude תרומה, as the last step showed. So the גמרא uses a word of the פסוק instead. ״בה״ narrows the verse, and תרומה is what it removes. That leaves holy food (קדשים) as the case the verse covers.

keyTerms.meaning: 'Through it / through which', a small word used here to narrow the verse
To exclude
The portion of produce given to a כהן

phrases.english: The verse says: 'through which';
phrases.notes: ויקרא 5:3

phrases.english: 'through which' comes to exclude תרומה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 1 with a word from the verse instead of logic
steps.terutzResolutionType: Textual exclusion from a word in the פסוק
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Since lack of כרת doesn't block it, תרומה could be included

steps.title: Maybe ״בה״ excludes the מקדש instead
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges: maybe ״בה״ excludes entering the מקדש while טמא. That sin is so serious that a קרבן עולה ויורד would not be enough, and a fixed קרבן would be needed.
steps.simpleTranslation: Say instead that ״בה״ excludes the מקדש: a sliding-scale offering is not enough for him, and he must bring a fixed offering!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא questions the last answer. It offers another reading: ״בה״ might exclude the מקדש, not תרומה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If ״בה״ excludes מקדש, it would mean that sin is too serious for a sliding-scale offering and needs a fixed קרבן. Then ״בה״ says nothing about תרומה. So nothing so far shows that the verse means holy food rather than תרומה. The next steps answer this by bringing רבי's direct source.

keyTerms.meaning: Say instead, offering another possible reading
The Temple; here, entering it while טמא
It is not enough for him
A fixed offering that is the same for rich and poor

phrases.english: Say instead: 'through which' comes to exclude the Temple;

phrases.aramaic: דְּלָא סַגִּי לֵיהּ בְּקׇרְבָּן עוֹלֶה וְיוֹרֵד
phrases.english: that a sliding-scale offering is not enough for him
until he brings a fixed offering!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the reading of ״בה״ given in step 2
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The same word could just as well exclude the more serious case of מקדש, so it gives no proof about תרומה

steps.title: רבא praises רבי for his deep reading
steps.stepSummary: רבא applies to רבי the description 'one who draws water from deep wells,' praising the depth of his reading of the verses.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא read about רבי: 'He draws water from deep wells.'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge by pointing to רבי, whom רבא praises as someone who pulls water up from very deep wells. This sets up the next step, which quotes רבי's ברייתא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The picture is of someone who reaches far below the surface to bring something up. רבא praises רבי's reading that the קרבן עולה ויורד covers eating holy food while טמא. The praise shows the גמרא stands behind רבי's teaching even after these challenges.

keyTerms.meaning: Applied a verse to him, describing him with a פסוק
Draws water
Deep wells

steps.whatToRemember: The word ״בה״ could exclude either תרומה or מקדש, so it alone proves nothing. רבא answers by pointing to רבי, whose deep reading (next step) directly links the פסוק to eating holy food while טמא.

phrases.english: Rava read about Rabbi:
phrases.notes: Here 'רבי' means רבי יהודה הנשיא, the one whose teaching this section is about.

phrases.english: 'One who draws water from deep wells.'
phrases.notes: Based on משלי 20:5

steps.triggerLanguage: קרי רבא עליה דרבי דולה מים מבורות עמוקים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 3 by turning to רבי's deep reading of the verses, which the next step quotes
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The גמרא backs רבי's derivation, calling it a deep reading of the verses

steps.title: The ברייתא of רבי: a word-link shows the פסוק is about eating קדשים while טמא
steps.stepSummary: רבי asks why the פסוק mentions ״בהמה״ when ״חיה״ would have been enough. He answers that it is there to link this פסוק with the one about eating קדשים while טמא, which also says ״בהמה טמאה״.
steps.simpleTranslation: As we learned in a ברייתא: רבי says, I could read just ״חיה״. So why does the פסוק also say ״בהמה״? It says ״בהמה טמאה״ here, and it says ״בהמה טמאה״ in another place. In that other place the topic is making קדשים טמא. So here too, the topic is making קדשים טמא.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now quotes the actual ברייתא of רבי, the one רבא just praised as drawing water from deep wells. It shows how רבי found the topic of the פסוק.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The word ״חיה״ can also cover a domestic animal, so the extra word ״בהמה״ looks unnecessary. רבי says the extra word is there to make a גזירה שוה with ויקרא 7:21, which deals with eating קדשים while טמא. That ties the קרבן עולה ויורד of ויקרא 5 to טומאת קודש.

keyTerms.meaning: Learning a law from one פסוק to another because both use the same word or phrase
Eating or touching קדשים (holy offerings) while טמא
A wild animal; the word can also include a domestic animal
A domestic animal
"Over there": the other פסוק being compared

steps.whyThisMatters: This is the base source showing that the קרבן עולה ויורד for טומאה is about קדשים. The rest of the סוגיא builds on it.

phrases.english: As it is taught in a ברייתא: רבי says:
I could read just "חיה" (animal);
phrases.notes: ויקרא 5:2. ״חיה״ can include a domestic animal too, so this one word would have been enough.

phrases.english: so why was "בהמה" (domestic animal) stated?
It says here "an impure domestic animal,"
and it says over there "an impure domestic animal";
phrases.notes: ויקרא 7:21, about someone who eats קדשים while טמא.

phrases.english: just as over there it is about making holy food impure,
so too here it is about making holy food impure.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Supplies the ברייתא behind רבא's praise of רבי in step 4
steps.raayaObject: That the קרבן עולה ויורד for טומאה applies to טומאת קודש
steps.raayaSupportSource: The ברייתא of רבי, using a גזירה שוה on ״בהמה טמאה״ (ויקרא 5:2 and 7:21)

steps.title: Where do we learn entering the מקדש while טמא?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks: we now have a source for טומאת קודש, but what is the source for טומאת מקדש?
steps.simpleTranslation: We found a source for making holy food impure. Where do we learn making the מקדש impure?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא notes that רבי's גזירה שוה only covers קדשים. It asks for a source for entering the מקדש while טמא, and sets up the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The גזירה שוה with ויקרא 7:21 only links the פסוק to eating קדשים. But the הלכה is that the קרבן עולה ויורד also covers the מקדש, so a separate source is needed.

keyTerms.meaning: "We have found": we already have a source for this part
Entering the מקדש while טמא
"From where do we know?"

phrases.english: We have found a source for making holy food impure;
from where do we know making the Temple impure?

steps.triggerLanguage: אַשְׁכְּחַן טוּמְאַת קוֹדֶשׁ, טוּמְאַת מִקְדָּשׁ מְנָלַן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Points out that the source from step 5 only covers קדשים
steps.sheelahInformationSought: A source showing that טומאת מקדש is also included in the קרבן עולה ויורד

steps.title: A היקש puts the מקדש together with קדשים
steps.stepSummary: The פסוק about a woman after childbirth says she may not touch קודש and may not enter the מקדש. Placing them side by side teaches that the מקדש is treated like קודש.
steps.simpleTranslation: The פסוק says: "She may not touch any holy thing, and she may not come into the מקדש." The מקדש is compared to holy things.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers with a היקש. The מקדש and קודש appear together in one פסוק, so whatever applies to one applies to the other.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 5 showed that the קרבן עולה ויורד covers טומאת קודש. ויקרא 12:4 puts מקדש right next to קודש, so the same קרבן also covers entering the מקדש while טמא.

keyTerms.meaning: Learning a law by comparing two things that a פסוק places next to each other
"It was compared": the two were linked by a היקש

phrases.english: The verse says:
"She may not touch any holy thing,
phrases.notes: ויקרא 12:4, about a woman after giving birth.

phrases.english: and she may not come into the Temple" —
the Temple is compared to holy things.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר קְרָא: ״בְּכׇל קֹדֶשׁ לֹא תִגָּע וְאֶל הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לֹא תָבֹא״
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The היקש in ויקרא 12:4 links מקדש to קודש, so the מקדש is also covered

steps.title: Then תרומה should be included too
steps.stepSummary: If we rely on ״בכל קדש לא תגע״, that same phrase is known to include תרומה. So eating תרומה while טמא should also bring a קרבן עולה ויורד.
steps.simpleTranslation: If so, תרומה should be included too! For the Master said: "She may not touch any holy thing" comes to include תרומה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the היקש it just used. The same words, ״בכל קדש״, are known to include תרומה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The word ״כל״ in ״בכל קדש״ was already learned to add תרומה. If the קרבן is built on this פסוק, תרומה should come along. That would mean a קרבן for eating תרומה while טמא, which is not the הלכה.

keyTerms.meaning: "If so": introduces a problem that follows from what was just said
The portion of produce given to a כהן; it may not be eaten while טמא
"To include": the word adds something extra

phrases.english: If so, תרומה too should be included —
as the Master said:
"She may not touch any holy thing" —
this comes to include תרומה!
phrases.notes: The word ״כל״, "any", is what adds תרומה.

steps.kashyaTarget: Using ״בכל קדש לא תגע״ as the base for the קרבן
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: That phrase also includes תרומה, so תרומה would wrongly need a קרבן עולה ויורד

steps.title: The word ״בה״ leaves out תרומה
steps.stepSummary: The תורה limited the קרבן with the word ״בה״, and that word excludes תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: But the Merciful One limited it with the word ״בה״.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the word ״בה״ in the פסוק of the קרבן limits it and keeps תרומה out.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Even though ״בכל קדש״ includes תרומה for the איסור, the קרבן פסוק has its own limiting word, ״בה״. So the קרבן does not cover תרומה. The גמרא is repeating its earlier answer from step 2, now inside the full chain from רבי's ברייתא.

keyTerms.meaning: "Excluded": a word that narrows the law
"The Merciful One": the תורה
"Through it": the limiting word in ויקרא 5:3

phrases.english: But the Merciful One excluded it with "through it."
phrases.notes: ויקרא 5:3.

steps.terutzResolutionType: A limiting word in the פסוק (מיעוט)
steps.terutzHavaAmina: תרומה would be included through ״בכל קדש״
steps.terutzMaskana: ״בה״ excludes תרומה from the קרבן עולה ויורד

steps.title: Maybe ״בה״ excludes the מקדש instead
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks: why say ״בה״ excludes תרומה? Maybe it excludes the מקדש.
steps.simpleTranslation: Say that ״בה״ comes to exclude the מקדש!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the answer. The limiting word ״בה״ could just as easily be keeping the מקדש out.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both תרומה and the מקדש were added through ״בכל קדש לא תגע״. A single limiting word could remove either one, so the גמרא asks why we choose to remove תרומה.

keyTerms.meaning: "Say instead": proposes another reading
"To exclude"

phrases.english: Say that "through it" comes to exclude the Temple!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges which item ״בה״ excludes in step 9
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The limiting word could just as well exclude the מקדש, which also came in through the same פסוק

steps.title: The מקדש stays in because it has כרת, like קדשים
steps.stepSummary: It makes more sense not to exclude the מקדש, since entering it while טמא carries כרת, just like eating קדשים while טמא. So ״בה״ must be excluding תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: It makes sense that we do not exclude the מקדש, because it carries כרת just like holy food does.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers with logic. The מקדש is much closer to קדשים than תרומה is, so ״בה״ must be removing תרומה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Eating קדשים while טמא and entering the מקדש while טמא both carry the punishment of כרת. Eating תרומה while טמא does not. Since the מקדש matches the main case, it stays in, and the limiting word removes the weaker case, תרומה.

keyTerms.meaning: "It makes sense": an answer based on logic
The punishment of being cut off from the Jewish people
"Since": gives the reason
"Like it": the same as טומאת קודש

phrases.english: It makes sense that
we do not exclude the Temple,
since it carries כרת just like it.
phrases.notes: "Like it" means like eating holy food while טמא, the main case of the פסוק.

steps.triggerLanguage: מִסְתַּבְּרָא מִקְדָּשׁ לָא מְמַעֲטִינַן, שֶׁכֵּן בְּכָרֵת כְּמוֹתָהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 10; step 12 will reverse this reasoning
steps.terutzResolutionType: Logical reasoning (סברא) based on how similar the cases are
steps.terutzMaskana: The מקדש shares the כרת of קדשים, so it stays included and ״בה״ excludes תרומה

steps.title: On the contrary, תרומה is more similar because it involves eating
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא flips the reasoning of Step 11. Eating תרומה while טמא is an act of eating, just like eating קדשים while טמא. So maybe ״בה״ should exclude the מקדש and keep תרומה included.
steps.simpleTranslation: On the contrary! We should not exclude תרומה, because eating it is an act of eating, just like eating קדשים.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back on Step 11. Instead of comparing by punishment (כרת), it compares by type of action (eating), and that points the other way.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 11 said the מקדש is more like קדשים because both carry כרת. Now the גמרא says תרומה is more like קדשים because both are eaten. Each side has a similarity, so we cannot tell which one ״בה״ excludes, and the proof for the מקדש falls apart.

keyTerms.meaning: On the contrary; the reverse is more logical
We exclude (from a rule)
Eating
Like it; similar to it

steps.confusionAlert: This line does not say that eating תרומה while טמא really brings a קרבן. It only shows that the earlier logic could cut either way, so it cannot prove anything about the מקדש.

phrases.english: On the contrary, we should not exclude תרומה,
since it is eating, just like it!
phrases.notes: "Like it" means like eating קדשים while טמא, which is the main case of the קרבן.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Reverses the logic of Step 11, so the proof that ״בה״ excludes תרומה collapses.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The whole derivation of the מקדש from ״בכל קדש לא תגע״ together with ״בה״
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The comparison used in Step 11 (sharing כרת) is matched by an equally strong comparison (sharing the act of eating), so the reasoning does not decide which case is excluded.

steps.title: רבא learns טומאת מקדש from the three mentions of כרת by שלמים
steps.stepSummary: רבא brings a new source. The תורה says כרת three times about eating שלמים while טמא: one for the general rule, one for the specific case, and one for a טומאה written without details, which is טומאת קודש. Since טומאת קודש is already learned from רבי, that third mention is applied to טומאת מקדש.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, רבא said: Why does the תורה say כרת three times about שלמים? One is for the general rule, one is for the specific case, and one is for a טומאה written in the תורה without details, and I don't know what it is. So say it is טומאת קודש. But if it is not needed for טומאת קודש, since that is learned from רבי, apply it to טומאת מקדש.
steps.whatsHappening: After the last proof fell apart, רבא opens a fresh way to show that entering the מקדש while טמא is connected to the קרבן עולה ויורד. He finds a mention of כרת that seems extra and uses it for the מקדש.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each mention of כרת must teach something. The third one is tied to the unspecified טומאה in the פרשה of the קרבן עולה ויורד. That is already known for קודש through רבי's derivation, so the mention moves over ("תנהו ענין") to teach the מקדש.

keyTerms.meaning: Mentions of the punishment כרת (being cut off)
Peace-offerings
A general statement and a specific statement
Without details; unspecified
If it isn't needed for this topic, apply it to another topic
He derives it; it is learned from

steps.whyThisMatters: This uses a common method of דרשה: when a phrase isn't needed where it stands, it is moved to teach a related case. Here that method becomes a source for the מקדש.

phrases.english: Rather, רבא said:
Why are there three mentions of כרת regarding שלמים?
One is for the general rule,
and one is for the specific case,
and one is for a טומאה written in the תורה without details.
And I do not know what it is,
so you must say: it is טומאת קודש.
phrases.notes: This points to the פרשה of the קרבן עולה ויורד, which mentions being טמא without spelling out what was done.

phrases.english: But if it is not needed for טומאת קודש,
since that is learned from רבי,
apply it to the topic of טומאת מקדש.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶלָּא אָמַר רָבָא: שָׁלֹשׁ כָּרֵיתוֹת בִּשְׁלָמִים לָמָּה?
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Step 12 knocked down the previous proof, so רבא replaces it with a new source.
steps.raayaObject: Entering the מקדש while טמא is included in the פרשה of the קרבן עולה ויורד.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The third mention of כרת by שלמים, moved from טומאת קודש (already learned from רבי) to טומאת מקדש.

steps.title: The third mention of כרת is needed for רבי אבהו's teaching
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges רבא. The third mention of כרת is not extra, because רבי אבהו uses it to teach כרת for items that are not normally eaten.
steps.simpleTranslation: But this mention is needed for רבי אבהו's teaching! רבי אבהו said: Why does the תורה say כרת three times about שלמים? One is for the general rule, one is for the specific case, and one is for things that are not normally eaten.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks רבא's proof by showing that the "extra" mention of כרת already has its own job.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבא's method only works if the third mention is free to be moved to another topic. רבי אבהו uses that same mention for holy items that aren't normally eaten. If so, nothing is left over for the מקדש.

keyTerms.meaning: It is needed for (a different teaching)
Things that are not normally eaten

phrases.english: But this is needed
for the teaching of רבי אבהו!
For רבי אבהו said:
Why are there three mentions of כרת regarding שלמים?
One is for the general rule, and one is for the specific case,
and one is for things that are not normally eaten.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges רבא's derivation in Step 13 by claiming the third mention of כרת is already used.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבא's use of the third mention of כרת for טומאת מקדש
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A verse can only be moved to another topic if it has no job of its own. רבי אבהו gives the third mention its own job (items not normally eaten), so it is not available for the מקדש.

steps.title: Even for רבי שמעון the third mention is needed for the inner sin-offering
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא completes its challenge to רבא. רבי שמעון holds there is no כרת for items not normally eaten, so for him רבי אבהו's teaching does not apply. Even so, the third mention of כרת is not extra for him either. It teaches that one who eats a חטאת הפנימית while טמא gets כרת.
steps.simpleTranslation: And according to רבי שמעון, who says there is no כרת for impurity with items not normally eaten, the third mention comes to include the inner חטאת. You might have thought that since רבי שמעון says anything not offered on the outer מזבח the way שלמים are has no liability for פיגול, it also has no liability for impurity. The פסוק teaches that one is liable.
steps.whatsHappening: Step 14 used רבי אבהו to show the third mention of כרת is not extra. Now the גמרא shows that even רבי שמעון, who disagrees with רבי אבהו, still needs that mention for a different teaching.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The rejection of רבא now works for both opinions. For רבי שמעון, the third כרת teaches that a חטאת הפנימית carries כרת for eating it while טמא, even though it carries no פיגול. Since the mention is used up either way, it is not free to teach טומאת מקדש.

keyTerms.meaning: An inner sin-offering, whose blood is sprinkled inside the היכל and not on the outer מזבח
The outer altar in the courtyard
A קרבן made invalid because it was brought with the intent to eat it after its proper time; eating it carries כרת
Items of קדשים that are not normally eaten
It teaches us

steps.confusionAlert: רבי שמעון really does hold that there is no פיגול liability for the חטאת הפנימית. Only the extension of that rule to טומאה is the 'you might have thought' part. The conclusion is that for טומאה there IS כרת, even though for פיגול there is not.

phrases.english: And according to Rabbi Shimon, who says:
items that are not normally eaten,

phrases.aramaic: אֵין חַיָּיבִין עֲלֵיהֶן כָּרֵת מִשּׁוּם טוּמְאָה;
phrases.english: one is not liable to כרת for them because of impurity;
phrases.notes: So for him, רבי אבהו's use of the third כרת from Step 14 does not work.

phrases.english: the third mention comes to include the inner sin-offering.
For it could enter your mind to say,
since Rabbi Shimon said:

phrases.aramaic: כֹּל שֶׁאֵינוֹ קָרֵב עַל מִזְבֵּחַ הַחִיצוֹן כִּשְׁלָמִים
phrases.english: anything that is not offered on the outer altar the way peace-offerings are,
one is not liable for it because of פיגול,
then also not because of impurity;
so it teaches us that one is liable.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Extends the challenge of Step 14 to the opinion of רבי שמעון
steps.kashyaTarget: רבא's claim (Step 13) that the third mention of כרת is free to teach טומאת מקדש
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Under either opinion the third כרת already has a job: רבי אבהו's teaching, or for רבי שמעון the חטאת הפנימית. So it is not free for טומאת מקדש.

steps.title: The Sages of Nehardea count three mentions of impurity
steps.stepSummary: The חכמי נהרדעי give a new version of רבא's proof. It is based on the three times the תורה mentions טומאה by שלמים, not the three mentions of כרת. One is for the general rule, one is for the specific case, and one is for a טומאה the תורה writes without details.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, the Sages of נהרדעא say in the name of רבא: why are there three mentions of impurity by שלמים? One is for the general rule, one is for the specific case, and one is for a טומאה written in the תורה without details, and I do not know what it is.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא drops the earlier version and brings a reworked version of רבא's proof. This step sets up the count, and the next step finishes the proof.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Steps 14-15 showed the three mentions of כרת are all needed. So the חכמי נהרדעי shift the focus to the word טומאה, which also appears three times in the same פסוקים. The third mention points to some unspecified case of טומאה.

keyTerms.meaning: The Sages of the city of נהרדעא
The general rule
The specific case
Stated without details

steps.confusionAlert: This sounds almost the same as Step 13, but the count is different. Step 13 counted the word כרת, while here we count the word טומאה.

phrases.english: Rather, the Sages of Nehardea say in the name of Rava:
Why are there three mentions of impurity with peace-offerings?
phrases.notes: These are the same three פסוקים of כרת from Step 13 (ויקרא 7:20, 7:21, 22:3). Each one also mentions being טמא.

phrases.english: One is for the general rule, and one is for the specific case,
and one is for a defiling written in the Torah without details.
and I do not know what it is,

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Replaces רבא's rejected version with a new count based on the mentions of טומאה
steps.raayaObject: That טומאת מקדש has a source tying it to the laws of טומאה by קדשים
steps.raayaSupportSource: The three mentions of טומאה in the פסוקים about eating שלמים while טמא

steps.title: The extra mention is applied to the Temple
steps.stepSummary: The unspecified טומאה would normally mean טומאת קודש. But טומאת קודש is already learned from רבי, so the extra mention is moved over to teach טומאת מקדש.
steps.simpleTranslation: You must say it means defiling קדשים. And if it is not needed for defiling קדשים, since that is learned from רבי, apply it to defiling the מקדש.
steps.whatsHappening: The חכמי נהרדעי finish their proof and land on טומאת מקדש.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The extra mention first points to the plain case of the unspecified טומאה, which is טומאת קודש. Since that case already has its own source from רבי, the mention is free and gets moved over to the other case, טומאת מקדש. This is the standard move of 'if it does not apply here, apply it there.'

keyTerms.meaning: You must say
Eating sacred food while טמא
Entering the מקדש while טמא
If it is not needed for this case, apply it to another one

phrases.english: You must say it is the defiling of sacred food;
phrases.notes: This is the קרבן עולה ויורד section, which talks about טומאה without spelling out the case.

phrases.english: and if it is not needed for the defiling of sacred food,
since he learns that from Rabbi,
apply it to the defiling of the Temple.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the proof begun in Step 16
steps.raayaSupportSource: The third mention of טומאה by שלמים, freed up because טומאת קודש is learned from רבי

steps.title: The word impurity is needed to go with each כרת
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the חכמי נהרדעי. The third mention of טומאה is not extra. Since the תורה had to write כרת a third time for רבי אבהו's teaching, it had to say what the כרת is for. A כרת cannot be written without naming the sin.
steps.simpleTranslation: But this mention is also needed. Since the תורה needed to write כרת for רבי אבהו's teaching, it also wrote the word for impurity, because it could not do without it.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא knocks down the Nehardea version too. The extra mention of טומאה comes along with the needed mention of כרת.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The mentions of טומאה are tied to the mentions of כרת. Once the third כרת is needed for רבי אבהו, the word טומאה next to it is needed just to make the sentence make sense. So nothing is extra, and there is still no source for טומאת מקדש.

keyTerms.meaning: Since anyway
It cannot do without this
It is needed for something else

steps.whatToRemember: Both versions of רבא's proof are rejected. The three mentions of כרת are all used, and the three mentions of טומאה simply go along with them. So רבא brings a different source in the next step.

phrases.english: But this one is also needed:
since it had to write כרת
for the teaching of Rabbi Abbahu,
phrases.notes: This is the teaching from Step 14: there is כרת even for items not normally eaten.

phrases.english: it also wrote the word for impurity,
since it could not do without it!
phrases.notes: A punishment of כרת makes no sense unless the פסוק says what it is for.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the Nehardea version of רבא's proof
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that the third mention of טומאה is extra
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The word טומאה must go with the third כרת, which is needed for רבי אבהו. So it is not free to be applied to טומאת מקדש.

steps.title: רבא's new proof from the word "his impurity"
steps.stepSummary: רבא drops the earlier approach. He brings a new source, a גזירה שוה on the word ״טוּמְאָתוֹ״. He starts by quoting the verse "here", in the passage of the sliding-scale offering: ״לְכֹל טוּמְאָתוֹ״.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, רבא said: we learn it from the word "his impurity" and "his impurity". It is written here: "in any manner of his impurity"...
steps.whatsHappening: After the last proof was knocked down, רבא offers a brand-new source: the same word appears in two places, so one place teaches about the other. This line is setting up the proof. It quotes the first verse, and the matching verse comes in the next line.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The earlier attempts relied on extra mentions in the שלמים passage, and the גמרא showed that none of them was really extra. So רבא switches to a different kind of source, a גזירה שוה, which links two passages by a shared word. The first link is ״לְכֹל טוּמְאָתוֹ״ in the passage of the sliding-scale offering (ויקרא 5:3).

keyTerms.meaning: Rather. It signals that the earlier approach is dropped and a new one is coming.
It comes from, meaning it is learned from.
A teaching that links two passages because the same word appears in both.
His impurity. This is the shared word that links the two verses.
It is written here. This introduces the first of the two linked verses.

steps.confusionAlert: This line is only half of the proof. You have the verse "here", but you still need the verse "there" before you can see what רבא is learning. Don't try to finish the proof yet.

phrases.english: Rather, Rava said:
It is learned from "his impurity" and "his impurity";
phrases.notes: The same word appears in two verses, and that shared word links them. This is a גזירה שוה.

phrases.english: it is written here: "in any manner of his impurity,"
phrases.notes: ויקרא 5:3

steps.relationToPreviousStep: The proof from the extra mentions in the שלמים passage was rejected in step 18, so רבא replaces it with a new source, a גזירה שוה.
steps.raayaObject: That the sliding-scale offering covers טומאת מקדש.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A גזירה שוה on the word ״טוּמְאָתוֹ״. It begins with ״לְכֹל טוּמְאָתוֹ״ (ויקרא 5:3), and the matching verse follows in the next line.
